messages.text: The Stone Gate toll is 8 copper today.
The posted Stone Gate toll says 10 copper.
I have not seen the gatekeeper confirm either amount.

product.title: Regional Dispatch: Gate Fees and Local Commerce
product.subtitle: Discrepancies noted at regional checkpoints.

main_story.headline: Confusion Reigns Over Current Toll Rate at Stone Gate
main_story.lede: Local residents questioned the prevailing cost of passage through a major checkpoint following conflicting accounts of fees charged for using *Stone Gate*.
main_story.body:
**Dera** and **Fenn** initiated a discussion regarding the required payment at the gate. While one individual stated that the toll was 8 copper, another noted a posted rate of 10 copper. This discrepancy led to questions about official confirmation of the correct fee.

The exchange highlighted the confusion surrounding current pricing for regional access points, emphasizing that neither party could confirm if the posted signage or an individual transaction represented the accurate requirement. The conversation remained strictly focused on resolving the immediate financial obligation required for passage.
